item.title: OGE Dissertation and Thesis Workshop
item.description: Date: Tuesday, September 29, 2026 6:00 PM - 7:30 PM - Learn the basics of correct thesis organization and format, appropriate paper attribution and reference citation styles—plus a review of the most commonly found mistakes and ways to avoid them. This workshop is for any student who will be writing a MS thesis or PhD dissertation. Bring your questions! To register for this WebEx event:https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdb_PUv7ttd7y4V1TtPjyVmIPE7Jp9GsXOKDzOjFLMWf3a47Q/viewform?usp=header

item.title: STEM-Designated MS in Econ Info Session #1
item.description: Level up your career in just one more year! Discover our STEM-Designated MS in Econ program. Gain advanced quantitative and research skills to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex data, backed by a flexible curriculum. Come see if it’s right for you. Registration is required. Session is September 30 at 11am.

item.title: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute: Industrial and Management Engineering (IME) and Systems Engineering and Technology Management (SETM)
item.description: We’d like to invite you to learn about two master’s graduate programs at RPI: Industrial and Management Engineering (IME) and Systems Engineering and Technology Management (SETM). Join Professor Esra Agca Aktunc for a virtual information session on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. EDT and learn how these programs combine math and engineering with data science, management, and human behavior. Register Today! https://apply.rpi.edu/register/?id=10b84a2a-c64d-4978-a1fc-57511eba6753

item.title: Order of the Engineer Registration
item.description: Date: Monday, September 28, 2026 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM - The Order of the Engineer Ceremony will be held on Wednesday, October 28th, 7:00 PM at EMPAC. The Order is open to all senior engineering students, or those that have graduated within the past year. You must be present at the ceremony to receive your ring.
